conversion=None CRDs and unlabeled MRs: untouched
admission chain: invokes MWC/VWC on every CR write

caBundle must match the leaf the webhook server is currently serving
MWC/VWC path — synchronous apply from WebhookReconciler to the target apiserver
ManagedResource path — label-scoped watch + read/stamp of MR Secrets on hosting
Certificate writes — generate / stage / promote / prune the Cert Secret
Disk + serving — reloader writes files, webhook server answers HTTPS calls from target
GRM path — gardener-resource-manager bridges hosting Secrets to target CRDs
Async signal — non-blocking rotation fan-out between reconcilers
Target-internal — apiserver dispatches to MWC/VWC/CRD webhooks during requests
All cross-cluster arrows route through the empty corridor between the two cluster boxes.
No arrow crosses any box; vertical segments in the corridor are at distinct x-coordinates per path.
